reasoning_content: Good - there's a git repo. Let me commit the changes to git on the VPS:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Configure git and commit changes
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git config user.email 'openhands@all-hands.dev' && git config user.name 'OpenHands'")

# Add files
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git add server/src/core/WorldTick.ts server/src/index.ts server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts game-data/world/client-config.json")

# Commit
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git commit -m 'Fix: Agent integration, persistence, nginx proxy routes

- Add LegendPropagationSystem to WorldTick.tick()
- Add getActiveChunks/setChunkActive to ChunkSystem
- Enable nginx proxy routes: /ws, /api, /world, /client-config.json
- Add client-config.json with websocketUrl for client
- Fix SUPERBASE_URL check bypass
- Add DB credentials from Supabase container'")

print("Committed:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
